newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty eases vs basket, 1-day depos to above 23 pct.
newsitem.headline: Zloty eases vs basket, 1-day depos to above 23 pct.

text.p: 1325 GMT - The Polish zloty closed at 2.97/2.94 pct from the parity rate, weaker than Tuesday's 3.03/3.02 pct in live trade driven mainly by speculations mirroring dollar/mark moves and small foreign T-bills sales, dealers said.
* It closed at 3.0865/75 to the dollar, down from 3.0785/95 on Tuesday and at 1.8240/45 to the mark against 1.8240/49.
* One-day depos up on shortage on squaring of average reserve accounts, NBP refrains from drainage operations.
* O/N at 23.10/23.30 pct vs opening's 22.55/22.75 pct.
* T/N at 23.15/23.35 pct vs opening's 22.80/23.30 pct.
